chunks: And what is narrated in it from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri regarding the will of the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) to Ali (peace be upon him), which begins with: 'O Ali, when the bride enters your house,' I have narrated it from Muhammad ibn Ibrahim ibn Ishaq al-Talqani (may Allah be pleased with him) from Abu Sa'id al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Adawi, from Yusuf ibn Yahya al-Asbahani Abu Ya'qub, from Abu Ali Isma'il ibn Hatim, who said: Abu Ja'far Ahmad ibn Salih ibn Sa'id al-Makki narrated to us, who said: Umar and Ibn Hafth narrated to us, from Ishaq ibn Najih, from Husayn, from Mujahid, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) entrusted his will to Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) and said: 'O Ali, when the bride enters your house,' and he narrated the hadith in its entirety as recorded in this book.
ai.seo_question: What is the chain of narration for the Prophet's will to Ali regarding the bride entering the house?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq meticulously documents the isnad for the Prophet’s specific advice to Imam Ali regarding marital etiquette, tracing it through a chain that includes Abu Sa'id al-Khudri and the scholar al-Tabarani. This narration highlights the Shia emphasis on the Prophet’s direct guidance to Ali as a source of legal and spiritual instruction for the community. The inclusion of this specific chain underscores the reliability of transmitting practical rulings from the Ahl al-Bayt.
